bio.text: Ronny Jackson was elected to represent Texas's 13th Congressional District in November 2020.
A graduate of Texas A&M University and the University of Texas Medical Branch, he served 25 years in the U.S. Navy and retired as a Rear Admiral in December 2019.

He served in the White House Medical Unit during the George W. Bush administration, then as Physician to the President under the Obama and Trump administrations, and in January 2019 was appointed Chief Medical Advisor and Assistant to the President.
